notes.title: Bug Fixes Galore!
notes.content:
This update fixes a lot of the most glaring issues. And we're not done yet! More updates will coming soon. So keep playing and have fun!

[list]
[*] Added Reload Save button
[*] Fixed Tool Wheel
[*] Fixed Menu cursor alignment
[*] Fixed soft lock getting key from Botan (hopefully)
[*] Fixed Target Challenge timer
[*] Fixed Photo Spot for Gen's sidequest
[*] Fixed VR Hand oriented movement
[*] Fixed Photos colored by time of day
[*] Reduced Fishing timer considerably
[*] Improved Botan watch tutorial
[*] Lots of music leveling fixes
[*] Lots of other audio improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Sushi Ben - Available Now!!
notes.content:
[h2]The wait is over! [i]Sushi Ben[/i] is available now! [/h2][h2]Join the fun in Kotobuki Town today![/h2][p]
Welcome to [b]Kotobuki town[/b], a quaint community currently being gobbled up acre by acre by dastardly big-city landsharks. It’s also your new home. Do you have what it takes to bring the locals together and save their beloved sushi bar?[/p][p align="start"]Inspired by slice-of-life anime, [i]Sushi Ben[/i] is a sweet, funny and bombastic narrative adventure about finding your feet in a new town (and sticking it to landlords while you’re at it).[/p]

notes.title: Sushi Ben Plushie!
notes.content:
You wanted it and now the Kotobuki Postal Service is delivering! We're launching a brand new plushie featuring your favorite Sushi Ben character, Pot-chan!

Then [url=https://www.discord.gg/Jj3AUAAP8D]join us on Discord[/url] to get an exclusive server role!

notes.title: Sushi Ben Developer Stream
notes.content: Will those dastardly landsharks take over Daruma Sushi and ruin the lovely seaside town of Kotobuki? Can the developer catch the biggest tuna fish? Is Watson the cutest puppy to ever go for a walk in a VR game? Find out the answers to all this and more, as the developers stream some Sushi Ben gameplay!
